purpose: Verify before execution that the frozen V70 train-only gate does not repeat the historical correlation-function normalization error and that its paired comparison is mathematically symmetric.

power_normalization.truth_accumulator: sum the identical SpectralBinner power over the 16 fixed queries, then divide by objects_per_domain
power_normalization.candidate_accumulator: sum the identical SpectralBinner power over the same 16 queries and 16 members, then divide by objects_per_domain times members
power_normalization.band_reduction: form candidate-over-truth for each finite radial bin and average those ratios with the frozen mode-count weights
power_normalization.conclusion: No missing volume, query, member, FFT, or mode-count asymmetry was found in the frozen total-power comparison.

phase_sensitive_energy_score.first_term: mean over members of the Euclidean distance from generated to truth Fourier coefficients, divided by sqrt(number_of_selected_modes)
phase_sensitive_energy_score.second_term: sum over unordered member pairs divided by M times (M-1)
phase_sensitive_energy_score.coefficient_interpretation: This is the unbiased ensemble energy-score estimator because one half of the ordered off-diagonal mean equals the unordered-pair sum divided by M times (M-1).
phase_sensitive_energy_score.conclusion: The pair term is not missing a factor of two and the comparison cannot be improved by a one-point-only rescaling.

one_point_normalization.latent_moments: pool exact truth or generated latent voxels across the same fixed queries within each domain and stream
one_point_normalization.physical_tail_truth: mean over fixed backbone-selected truth voxels
one_point_normalization.physical_tail_candidate: mean over the identical fixed mask, queries, and all members
one_point_normalization.conclusion: Truth and candidate physical-tail moments are means on the same conditioning-defined population; the ensemble count is not left in the ratio.

decision.authorization: run the already-frozen train-only gate exactly once after the fixed 30000-step fit completes
